title: Getting the wrong end of the stick

ai.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir elected government has failed to address public grievances and deliver promised statehood, leading to widespread dissatisfaction with its governance.

facts.claim: lack of statehood and LG’s overriding powers have disabled the elected UT government from performing to its potential
facts.quote: There is no doubt that lack of statehood and LG’s overriding powers have disabled the elected UT government from performing to its potential,

facts.claim: the government has generally disappointed the public at large due to its lackadaisical attitude and unwillingness to grapple with real problems on ground
facts.quote: but then it is also true that the government has generally disappointed the public at large due to its lackadaisical attitude and unwillingness to grapple with real problems on ground.

facts.claim: common people expected the new government to provide them easy access to the administration for redressal of grievances
facts.quote: They expected the elected government to assert its authority over the administration to provide much better governance through people friendly policies and measures.
